records.notes: Primary document (opened): Solar data sheet DS65PG/1218 'TAURUS 65 Gas Turbine Generator Set' (2018, scene7 CM20150703-52095-38597). Cross-checked with BIL/0622 (2022), BPGPSG/116 (2016), BIL/512 (2012), BO&G/811 (2011), Turbomach Taurus 65 sheet (2008, C10518775), Turbomach handbook BPHBTBM/512 (2012), BPGPH/0525 (2025), Michelin case CSCHP-MRK/616 (2016), DSVET-HRSG/0419 (2019). Manufacturer product page solarturbines.com NOT openable in this session (WebFetch: host not resolved; curl: Akamai 'Access Denied' 403) - its values are known only from search-index extracts and are not used. RATING EDITIONS (important for an engine swap in an existing package - the installed unit may carry either rating): (a) 6500 kWe edition - DS65PG/1218 and BIL/0622: 6500 kWe, 10 860 kJ/kWe-hr (10,295 Btu), exhaust 76 880 kg/hr = 21.36 kg/s (unit conversion), 540 C (1000 F), efficiency 33 % (data sheet) / 33.1 % (BIL/0622); TAKEN as the newest opened manufacturer rating. (b) 6300 kWe edition - Turbomach 2008/2012, BIL/512 (2012), BPGPSG/116 (2016): 6.30 MW, 10 945 kJ/kWe-hr (10,375 Btu), 21.1 kg/s (Turbomach) / 76.0 thousand kg/hr (BPGPSG/116), 549-550 C, 32.9 %. (c) 6000 kWe launch rating (2004 press release, search extract only, not opened). The product page as indexed shows 6500 kWe together with the (b) heat rate/exhaust figures (10,945 kJ, 75,950 kg/hr, 550 C) - internally inconsistent; the earlier record (10945 / 21.1 / 550 / 32.9) came from there and is corrected to the data sheet. Spread between editions: exhaust flow 21.10-21.36 kg/s (1.2 %), exhaust temperature 540-550 C. eff_pct 33.1 is PUBLISHED (BIL/0622 'Taurus 65 6500 33.1'; DS65PG/1218 rounds to 33 %); 3600/10860 = 33.15 agrees. Fuel input check 6500 x 10860/3600 = 19.6 MJ/s; exhaust 21.36 kg/s vs inlet airflow 21 kg/s (46.4 lb/s) - consistent. Design (DS65PG/1218): industrial single-shaft; 13-stage axial compressor with variable inlet guide vanes and stators, PR 15:1, vertically split case; annular combustor with 10 SoLoNOx injectors; 3-stage reaction turbine; 3 tilt-pad radial journal bearings + active tilt-pad thrust + inactive fixed tapered-land thrust; epicyclic main reduction drive to a 4-pole generator (1500/1800 rpm). out_rpm (gearbox input = turbine speed): not published in any opened document - null. Package: 9.8 x 2.6 x 3.3 m, 39 600 kg (DS65PG/1218 = BIL/0622 = BPGPSG/116) taken; older editions: BIL/512 39 620 kg; BO&G/811 (2011, unenclosed approx.) 9.8 (32'0") x 2.5 (8'2") x 2.9 m, 33 045 kg; Turbomach-built packages 11.0 x 2.2 x 6.6 m incl. filter, 56 t - check the actual package drawing of the installed unit. Engine removal per drawing DS65PG-003C: sideways, 3.0 m clearance along the package side. Not published in any opened document - null: engine (core) weight and dimensions, turbine/gearbox-input speed, starter power, fuel gas supply pressure, lube tank volume/flow/heat rejection, number of variable stator rows, bleed valves, accessory gearbox, engine change time. No Taurus 65 Turbomachinery Package Specification found on manualsdir.com (only Taurus 60 TPS60CSMD/309 and Taurus 70); siemens-energy.com and centraxgt.com not consulted (other manufacturers, no Solar documents expected). Taurus 65 is GS only (no MD record).
